findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "sec-filings-tenders" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: sec_filings, sec_filings_batch, tenders_awards · Public sink: sec_filings_batch.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: sec_filings, sec_filings_batch, tenders_awards · Public sink: sec_filings_batch

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
